description: The ready-made Instagram automations, the same ones as the template gallery in the app. For example: send a link when people comment a word, answer story replies, ask for a follow first, or collect emails. Each one has an id, a name, a goal, what starts it, and the message it sends. asks_for says what sprkly_create_automation_from_template needs besides the template id and the account: a post, a keyword, a link, faq (a list of words and answers), whatsapp (a phone number and/or a WhatsApp username), or telegram (a t.me group or channel link). Every plan has automations.
name: sprkly_list_automation_templates
title: List automation templates
